title: Bike it or walk it? Xi'an's 13.7 km Ming wall | China Travel Expert
description:
You can go all the way around a 650-year-old city on top of its wall — so do you bike it or walk it?

Xi'an's Ming city wall is a complete rectangle, 13.74 km the whole way round, built from 1370 on older Tang foundations. It stands about 12 m tall and is flat and wide on top — wide enough that people cycle the full loop. Bikes rent at all four main gates, so you can pedal the battlements past 98 ramparts or take your time on foot.

🧭 Expert Tip: rent a bike at any gate (about ¥45 for roughly 3 hours) — a full lap is around 1.5 to 3 hours depending on your pace and the photo stops.
